name: Overlapping ownership effective dates
rationale: two register rows live at once, so the percentage for a month is ambiguous and the engine would silently pick one

name: Circular ownership
rationale: an entity in its own ownership path consolidates itself; the recursive walk must refuse rather than loop

name: Ownership register disagrees with the investment register
rationale: a subsidiary consolidated on a relationship nobody paid for. Both registers are internally consistent, so only the comparison between them finds it

name: Ownership percentages that do not complement
rationale: group share plus non-controlling share must be one; 0.80 and 0.10 leaves a tenth of the subsidiary owned by nobody

name: Equity retranslated at the closing rate
rationale: share capital does not move because a spot rate moved (FX-P03). Retranslating it makes CTA a plug, and the balance sheet still balances around it

name: Missing opening translation base
rationale: an entity with no registered acquisition-date rate (FX-P16) would translate its opening balance sheet at whatever the join happened to leave behind

name: Wrong historical rate on an opening balance sheet
rationale: a plausible but wrong rate translates cleanly and balances cleanly. Only the independent CTA expectation disagrees

name: One-sided intercompany difference (deferred from Phase 3)
rationale: USD 45,000 removed from one side of a pair. Both trial balances still close, the account maps, the dimension resolves -- the difference exists only when the two sides are put side by side, which is what the elimination engine does

name: Register relationship missing an acquisition schedule
rationale: the control walks the investment REGISTER, so a relationship with no schedule fails. A control walking the schedules could never see it

name: Investment eliminated before its acquisition date
rationale: eliminating a holding in months the group did not own it removes equity that was still outside the group, and every total remains plausible

name: Amortisation started at the beginning of the acquisition year
rationale: a whole-year charge on a mid-year acquisition. It is small, it is plausible, and it is wrong by exactly the months before completion

name: Opening accumulated amortisation greater than cost
rationale: an asset amortised past its own cost carries a negative net book value that the balance sheet absorbs without complaint, because the offsetting side is a real expense and the entry balances

name: Intercompany holding dropped from the unrealised profit run
rationale: the control iterates the holdings population, so a transaction the calculation never saw fails. A control reconciling only what was calculated cannot

name: Wrong quantity of intercompany stock still held
rationale: the provision is the surviving stock at its own layer margin, so overstating what survives overstates the provision. The entry balances and the balance sheet is unmoved in total; only the independent expectation disagrees

name: Management adjustment approved by nobody
rationale: an adjustment carrying an APPROVED status but no approver, preparer or rationale is unattributable. It posts cleanly and balances cleanly

name: Draft management adjustment must not be posted
rationale: the opposite assertion to a detection: a DRAFT adjustment carrying a real amount must never reach layer 4 at all. Proving the gate holds is worth as much as proving a control fires, and neither proves the other

name: Balance sheet account with no cash flow category
rationale: the cash flow ties by construction only if the categories partition the balance sheet. An uncategorised account still ties while reporting the wrong line

name: Balance sheet account mapped to two captions
rationale: an account presented in two captions is counted twice and the statement still balances, because both halves come from the same signed movement

name: Approved layer-4 adjustment with a real amount
rationale: the approved register holds only nil presentation reclassifications, so layer 4 is empty and the two bases are numerically identical. This fixture injects a real layer-4 amount and proves the statutory basis does not move: it is the empirical half of the proof that P4-LAY-03 and P4-BAS-01 make structurally
